description: Search property listings for sale or rent, filterable by district, estate, price, floor area, and property type.

parameters.name: listingType
parameters.description:
**Which side of the market to look at  -  `buy` (for sale) or `rent` (to let).**

28Hse keeps the two inventories completely separate, and the flag also decides how `priceMin`/`priceMax` are read:

- `buy`  -  買樓, for-sale listings. Price is the **total asking price in HKD**, e.g. `4720000` (shown on 28Hse as 售 $472 萬元).
- `rent`  -  租樓, to-let listings. Price is the **monthly rent in HKD**, e.g. `18000` (租 $18,000 元).

Every other filter  -  district, estate, area, bedrooms, building age  -  works the same on both sides.

Required on `/property-search`; optional on `/property-filters`, where it defaults to `buy`.

Ex: `buy`, `rent`

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**Free-text term  -  an estate, building, street or district name, in Chinese or English.**

Matched loosely against estate/building names and addresses. Chinese generally returns more than English, because most 28Hse inventory is listed in Chinese; a partial name works fine (`大埔` matches 大埔中心, 大埔廣場, 大埔花園 …).

- `太古城`  -  Taikoo Shing, Hong Kong Island
- `美孚新邨` or `Mei Foo`  -  Mei Foo Sun Chuen, Kowloon
- `將軍澳`  -  anything in/named after Tseung Kwan O

When the endpoint also takes ids, prefer them for precision: run the term through `/location-autocomplete` first, then pass the returned `id` as `estateIds`. Free text matches by name, an id matches exactly.

Ex: `太古城`, `Mei Foo`

parameters.name: districtIds
parameters.description:
**One or more district ids, comma-separated  -  the finest location filter available.** Optional.

A *district* here is a neighbourhood (大埔, 沙田, 銅鑼灣 …), **not** one of the four coarse `region` values, and the two use different id sets. Ids from different regions can be mixed; the result is their union (an OR, never an AND).

**Call `/property-filters` for the full list**  -  its `districts` array gives every id that filters, with the region and area each one belongs to. Common ones:

- `103`  -  大埔 Tai Po
- `102`  -  沙田 Sha Tin
- `19`  -  中環 Central
- `23`  -  銅鑼灣 Causeway Bay
- `30`  -  北角 North Point
- `62`  -  深水埗 Sham Shui Po
- `54`  -  觀塘 Kwun Tong
- `45`  -  鴨脷洲 Ap Lei Chau
- `103,102`  -  Tai Po **or** Sha Tin

An unknown id matches nothing rather than erroring, so check the id against `/property-filters` if a search comes back empty. Single-estate areas such as 太古城 or 美孚 are not districts on 28Hse  -  search those with `estateIds` from `/location-autocomplete`.

Ex: `103`, `103,102`

parameters.name: estateIds
parameters.description:
**One or more estate ids, comma-separated  -  restricts the search to specific estates/buildings.** Optional.

The most precise filter on this endpoint: `query` matches names loosely, an estate id matches exactly one estate. Multiple ids are OR-ed together.

- `4198`  -  逸雅苑 Yat Nga Court
- `1140,2520`  -  listings in either estate

Get ids from `/location-autocomplete` (type a name, read `id`), `/estate-search` (`estateId`), or any listing's `estateId`.

parameters.name: areaMin
parameters.description:
**Smallest floor area to include, in square feet  -  measured on *saleable* area (實用面積).** Optional.

- `500`  -  a typical 2-bedroom
- `1000`  -  large family flats and up

Ex: `500`

parameters.name: bedroomsMin

Ex: `1`, `2`, `3`

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
**Order the listings come back in.** Optional  -  defaults to 28Hse's own ranking.

- `default`  -  預設, the site's ranking (promoted and higher-`grade` listings first)
- `latest`  -  最新放盤, newest listing first
- `price_low` / `price_high`  -  price (or monthly rent) low→high / high→low
- `buildarea_low` / `buildarea_high`  -  gross area 建築 low→high / high→low
- `salesarea_low` / `salesarea_high`  -  saleable area 實用 low→high / high→low
- `unitprice_buildarea_low` / `unitprice_buildarea_high`  -  price per ft² of *gross* area
- `unitprice_salesarea_low` / `unitprice_salesarea_high`  -  price per ft² of *saleable* area

The per-ft² sorts are the ones to reach for when hunting value; the `salesarea` variants match how Hong Kong listings are normally compared, since saleable area is the quoted standard.

Ex: `latest`, `unitprice_salesarea_low`

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
**Page of results to fetch, 1-based.** Optional  -  defaults to `1`.

Every paginated response echoes `pagination: {count, page, totalPages}`; walk `page` upwards until it reaches `totalPages`. Page size is fixed by 28Hse (20 items on most feeds) and cannot be changed, so `count` divided by the items you receive tells you how deep the feed goes.

Ex: `1`, `2`, `7`

parameters.name: adId

**Numeric id of a single 28Hse property listing (廣告編號).** Required.

Every `/property-search` result carries one as `adId`, and it is also the number at the end of a listing URL:

- `https://www.28hse.com/buy/apartment/property-3939129` → `3939129`
- `https://www.28hse.com/rent/office/property-3972742` → `3972742`

If you have the URL rather than the id, pass it straight to `/property-details-by-url` instead of splitting it yourself.

An id whose listing has expired, sold, or been withdrawn returns `404`  -  listings are advertisements, so they do not live forever.

Ex: `3939129`
